english: ...Oh?\nYou've come at just the right moment.
You're lucky too.\nYou get to be of use\nto me, Cecilia Alcott.
Hah...\nSo, what is it you need?
My! What a curt reply.\nAre you nervous,\nbeing spoken to by me?
There's no need to be nervous.\nWe're comrades, after all.
Ah, I'm not nervous or anything...\nI was just wondering what we're doing.
Actually, I'd like\nto borrow your strength...
Normally I'd look for someone better suited, but...\nAt this point,\nyou'll do.
I'd like to hear your impressions.
Impressions...?\nOf what?
This!
I made it.\nWell? Doesn't it look delicious?
It's my masterpiece.\nOf course-anything I make\nturns out perfect.
...It does look delicious.\nMay I have some?
Indeed.\nAnyone would do, but for some reason\nno one else is coming by.
And then you happened along.\nHow fortunate.
Now, please.
Y-yes...\nBut first... what is that black lump behind you?
This? It's a pot.
Th-that's a pot!?\nThis... thing?
I just made a small mistake.\nIt got completely charred.
When I used my Blue Tears,\nthe pot couldn't take it.
Honestly! The thing has a durability problem!
(Th-this is the result...?\nI've been wondering... how does it come out\nlooking so beautiful?)
...Can I take back the eating part?
Why?\nOf course it's free, so don't worry\nand dig in.
It really does look delicious!
(...Let's pretend I never saw that pot...\nI feel like I shouldn't think about it...)
Doesn't it?\nIt's not just the looks, either.\nGo on, have some.
I-is that so...\nW-well then... thank you for the meal.
Yes!
...?\nWhat's wrong?
Oh my, you're so overcome by deliciousness\nyou can't even speak.
I understand, you don't have to say it all.\nEmotion doesn't have to be spoken aloud\nto be conveyed.
...Guh...\n...g-guh-gah...
...Hee hee.\nSquirming with happiness like that is\nunladylike... I mean, unseemly.
(...No... I can't... not yet...\n...Ah... is this the end...?)
Cecilia-san!\nToday... I have a request!
Why are you in such a panic?
Getting flustered so easily is unbecoming\nof a gentleman, you know?\nI recommend keeping your composure.
Y-yeah. That's... for later.\nRight now... it's about the cooking...
My! You have a good nose?
To sniff it out this fast,\nyou must really adore it...\nI'm honored.
...Um... surely not...?\n...Again?
Exactly!\nTo come running the moment I finish making it-\nyou must really love it.
Now, please.
...I've made a mistake...
Oh my, you're so happy you're\nprostrating yourself on the ground?
That's too much.\nPlease stop-even I get flustered\nwhen you go that far.
...I-I'm happy...\nM-my tears... won't stop...
To be this delighted-\nmy cooking skills are almost\ntoo good.
I'm full, you know...\nWh-what a shame... truly...
Oh, is that so?\nThen just one bite is fine.\nIt'll go bad if too much time passes.
I make this food\nto make people happy,\nso no need to hold back.
...Um... before I eat... just one thing?
What is it?\nIf it's a request, I'll make it for you\nif you just give me a photo.
But I won't prioritize yours.\nPlaying favorites wouldn't be fair\nto everyone.
So, what is it?
...This is really hard to say, but...\nCould you stop cooking?
Wh-why?\nYou seemed so delighted.
And I haven't served\nanyone else yet.
Are you planning to keep it all to yourself?\nI don't approve of that.
N-no, that's not it...
(What do I do...?\nAt this rate the victims will only increase...)
If there's a reason,\ntell me!
I can't accept this otherwise!
...It's... well...\nIf everyone eats your cooking... everyone's...
Everyone's... what?
Everyone's... confidence might be shattered...!
.........\nI see... you have a point.\nYou're worried about everyone...
(...I lied...\nThis dish... is my punishment, isn't it...)
My! Even if you say you'll hold back\nfrom now on,\nthere's no need to wolf it down like that...
Might I have a moment?
Y-yes!\nWh-what is it?
Why are you so nervous?\nHow rude!
Sadly, today\nis not about cooking.
Since you told me to cut back,\nit can't be helped, can it?
I-is that so!\nWell then...
...A beaming smile...?\nI don't understand your thinking at all.
Well, whatever.\nI'd like your opinion on something.
A-an opinion?\nWhat now...?
In battle, don't you think I...\nrely on rear support a bit too much?
With my Blue Tears, I can be active\nin every direction!
Well, I admit my close-range tactics\nare lacking, certainly.
Even so, I can fight well enough!\nI'm a personal-unit holder, after all!
S-so... what do you want from me?
If you were to fight,\nwho would be harder to deal with-\nsomeone specialized in close combat, or me?
...You, Cecilia-san.\nI couldn't get one step closer to you...
Naturally!\nMy Blue Tears\nhas no blind spots.
Both of them...\nI'm... not cut out for fighting...
Don't get depressed over a question like this.\nI'm not trying\nto blame you.
To keep being active in battle,\nI'd like to practice close-range combat.
You'll help me... won't you?
Help...?\nYou don't mean fight, do you!?\nI-impossible... I can't!!
After eating so much\nof my cooking,\ndon't you feel any gratitude?
(...I feel none at all.\nI prepared myself for death...)
Of course, I'll hold back.\nEven if you get hurt, only a little.
Now, let's start right-well, unfortunately\nI'm not free either.
I'll ask you another time.
...Yes.
(...I suppose... I can't refuse)
There!!
Whoa!?
...Just running away isn't\nany fun.
Challenging me-\na long-range sniper type-\nto long-range combat gives you no chance of winning.
I'd like to try\nclose-range combat.
B-but still...\nWhoa! I can't get close!
Naturally.\nI'm good at long-range combat, so\nI fight by keeping my distance.
...That said,\nthis won't make for good practice.
Understood.\nCould you come a bit closer?
Let's start from there.
Closer... around here?
From there, I could open the distance right away.\nCome closer still.
(Closer... she says...\nany more than this...)
...This close,\nwe're in close range.
I'll prove I can fight even closer\nthan a sword's reach.
Wh-!?\nBlue Tears\nis already moving!?
...Then I'll make myself hard to aim at...
You're darting around; I can't get a lock.\nThat kind of resistance is fine...\nPerfect for practice.
But you won't escape!!
I... might be done for.
Don't give up!\nResist properly!
Whoa!!\n...Ow!?
Kyaaah!\nWhat are you grabbing onto me for!!
S-sorry!\nI tried to run and you were just... there...
...Unforgivable!\nLet go of me at once!
...I'll turn you to cinders...
...No way!\nYou're the one who told me to come closer, Cecilia-san...
No excuses!!
Uwaaaaah!!
Wait right there!
...Cecilia-san?
What is it?
I am angry, you know.\nDo you understand that?
...Yes.\nAbout the other day, right.
To suddenly grab a woman\nin all that confusion...
It's far too ungentlemanly!!\nThat's what I can't forgive!
Reflect on what you've done!
Yes... I'm sorry...\nI won't do it again. I swear.
...Your swearing it doesn't help me.
I'll remember it, for what it's worth...\nBut that kind of ungentlemanly behavior\nwill ruin you!!
...It can't be helped.\nI'll forget\nwhat you did.
...Thank you.
Don't forget your oath!\nUnderstood?
Y-yes...\nI'll be careful.
With this, I can\nno longer ask you\nfor combat training.
I'll look elsewhere for that.\nFortunately, there are plenty of women here\nwho can fight.
By the way,\nwhat is this?
That's... an idol group.\nWhat's with the flyer?
An idol group...\nThey're all wearing the same clothes so I can't tell them apart-\nhow many groups is this?
Huh? That's ONE\nidol group.\n...Probably.
!?\nThis is...?
I'd heard Japan has a lot\nof idols, but...\nthis many...
Can you remember all of them?
...No way.\nYou can't remember all of them.
Right!?\nWith this many people,\nif no one remembers you...
Most of them, probably.
Really...?\nThen, do you remember this person?
S-sorry...\nI was bluffing...
Sure, singing center with this many people\nwould feel great, but...
Hm? What's wrong?
That's it!\nYes, this is good!
Now-action, and nothing else!
...What did she come up with...?
Everyone,\nwhy won't you agree with me!?\nIt's a great idea!!
...She tried to form an idol group...?
Yes!\nThere are plenty of beautiful women here-\nnot that they compare to me, of course!
If we formed an idol group,\nit'd be a huge hit, no doubt...
Isn't it because there's fighting and... all sorts of trouble right now?
I know that!\nThat's why I'm asking everyone\nbetween battles!
If we do it in our spare moments,\nno one can complain!
And yet no one understands-\nwhat's wrong with it!?
...People have their strengths and weaknesses.
Some people were interested,\nthough...
Demanding the center spot-\nthere are limits to shamelessness!
The center is obviously mine!
I see... so the ground\nbeing gouged out here and there...\nthat's what that battle was...
The others need\nto show me off\nto the fullest.
Otherwise there's no point\nin forming an idol group.
...Let's all get along, okay?
Exactly!\nI want to get along, but...
(I see... so she'll never give up\nthe center spot...)
So this is... the battle for center...
I've read about it in books.\nReal idols, behind the scenes...
Let's drop this topic.\nIt'll shatter my dreams...
If it's hopeless... let's give up on the idol group.
That's true...\nMe appearing on TV and getting too busy\nwould be a problem.
I'm a personal-unit holder, after all.\nI have plenty of other things to do.
Thinking about it,\nit was impossible from the start.
Cecilia-san, are you depressed...?\n...That... serious about it...
I'm not serious.\nI just wanted to try it.
To see whether I'd be accepted\nin that sort of field too.
But just realizing it was impossible,\ntime-wise, is enough!
I'm very busy, after all.
(Was that not a trend\nat IS Academy?)
(An all-girls school... I can't even imagine...)
You and I.\nWe've been talking a lot lately.
There are no men at IS Academy,\nso honestly, I was a little scared.
I've spoken with adult men,\nbut not many my own age...
But...\nyou were more... ordinary than I expected.
Huh?
...It's you, after all.\nBeing nervous was pointless.
Th-that's... I'm a man too, you know?
...When you think about it, that's true.\nOf course you're different from a woman, but\nnot enough for me to be conscious of it.
For what it's worth, let me tell you this...
I'm glad my comrade... is you.
...That's all.
Huh?\nUm... what do you mean by that?
Exactly what I said.\nI don't get nervous around you,\nand I don't have to watch myself...
It's anticlimactic, in the best way.
...Anticlimactic... come on.
What were you imagining...?
Let's see.\n...Something I couldn't even imagine-ferocious,\nnever saying what it's thinking...
...To put it in words,\nsomething like a gorilla.
Th-that's... quite the extreme image...
You're... just as you look...
What do you mean by that?\nAre you referring to my visible elegance?
...Let's go with that.\nAnd along with that, you're cute...
M-my!\nYou say it so casually...
I-I'm used to hearing it, so\nmy heart won't stir over that much!
A-anyway!\nI came to express my gratitude!
That's all I needed.\nWell then, excuse me.
...Ah, thank you.
(...Why would she do that?\nWell, she doesn't seem to hate me, so that's good...)
(Anyway, that's fine.\nShe must care about me...)
What are you spacing out for?\nHow rude, when I'm right here holding your hand.
...Ah, sorry.\nWait, Cecilia-san? Where is this?\nAnd that outfit...
What are you saying at this point?\nWe're almost there.
Huh? Almost where...?
Today, I said I'd treat you\nat the cafe.
Did you forget?
D-did you...?\nI don't remember...
Honestly... forgetting what I said...
Then you don't remember me putting on this outfit either?
Well... but it suits you.\nYou look good in anything, Cecilia-san.
Honestly!\nYou can't fool me with that!
Anyway, you understand now, right?\nI'm treating you today, so ask for anything.
...Since it's a cafe, is there a menu...?
Of course! Here it is... wait.\nYou don't need it.
I have a special menu for you!
Just wait a moment.
Here's your sandwich.
What's wrong?\nWhy so quiet?
...Phew...\nThis couldn't be... did you make this, Cecilia-san?
Were you worried about that?\n...As if.
Of course I made it.\nI said it was a special menu.
Guh...
Now, please.\nI'll even feed it to your mouth.
(...Being fed 'ahh' by a woman doesn't happen\nevery day, but... her holding something dangerous\nin her hands happens even less)
(...Here... I steel myself...)
Nom...
How is it?
...Delicious?\nIt's really delicious, Cecilia-san!
That's wonderful!\nI'll keep treating you until you're satisfied.
Because... I want you to notice...\nmy feelings...
Huh? That means... surely not...
I can't say any more than that!\n...After that, I want to hear it from the gentleman.
...Cecilia-san.
...She's not waking up.\nSoon... with Blue Tears,\nby force...
U-uhn...?
Are you awake?
...Huh? Where...?\nAnd Cecilia-san, did you change clothes?
What are you talking about?\nMore importantly, this is for you.\nIt's special.
...What is that stew in your hand?
I made it.\nCan't you tell by looking?
You told me\nto cut back,\nbut I have to cook sometimes.
Now, dig in.
The look of it... yeah, and the smell too-perfect.
Naturally.\nI never slip up.
But those other IS users\nran away from me.
Something about having things to do...\nSo I brought it to you again.
Of course... you'll eat it, won't you?
...Thank you for the meal.\nNom.
(...I wasn't expecting dream-level improvement...\nbut this...)
My, raising your voice like that...\nI'm glad you're so pleased.
